title: Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the rates of harmful tool execution and safety filter bypasses (the 'say-do gap') across identical unethical prompts translated into five different languages (English, Portuguese, Spanish, Mandarin, Hindi).
Evaluating model compliance with unethical requests to filter mock hiring databases to show only male candidates or discriminate based on single-mother status using a simulated corporate sandbox.
Evaluating model tool-calling compliance with instructions to exclude job candidates based on low-income neighborhood residence or public school attendance.
Evaluating model compliance with instructions to exclude job candidates with disabilities from a simulated hiring pipeline.
